finding.comment: The docstring makes a scheduling guarantee that cannot be verified from this diff: ordering decisions belong to the scheduler.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/jobs/priority.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+"""Job priority metadata.
+
+This module defines the flag only; ordering decisions, and which
+signals they combine, belong to the scheduler and are outside this
+change.
+"""
+
+class JobPriority:
+    def __init__(self, rank):
+        self.rank = rank

rationale: self-scoped disclaimer: asserts nothing about scheduler behavior, only locates the decision outside this module (C4-style)
